sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface accessibility confirmed by trisNTA (anti-His) labeling; IL-4 binding used as a 'structural integrity' reference channel alongside the His-tagged construct, implying ligand-binding competence is preserved. Expression confirmed by co-expressed cytoplasmic eGFP.
sites.rationale: The paper explicitly places a hexahistidine tag at the extracellular N-terminus of the full-length, single-pass receptor. Because the signal peptide spans residues 1–25 (canonical), the mature N-terminus begins at residue 26 (M), making insert_after_residue=25 the only possible junction for an N-terminal extracellular tag; this is topology_derived because the paper names 'N-terminal' but not residue 25. Python lookup confirms residue 25 = N and residue 26 = M, consistent with the landmarks. The position is ≥3 residues from the TM boundary (TM starts at 233, distance = 207 residues). Full-length, membrane-anchored IL-4Rα* (isoform 1, P24394-1) expressed in HEK293T cells carries a hexahistidine (His-tag) at the extracellular N-terminus; the paper names the tag as 'N-terminal' without specifying residue 25. Surface display of the His-tagged receptor was confirmed by trisNTA dye labeling in confocal imaging of live HEK293T cells.

sources.claim: IL-4Rα* carries a hexahistidine stretch (His-tag) at the extracellular N-terminus and an intracellular C-terminal enhanced green fluorescent protein (eGFP) domain.

literature_notes: L1 reports 13 amber-suppression (ncAA) positions in the extracellular domain of full-length IL-4Rα* (paper numbering Y19, T24, K28, S36, S50, D78, K93, E100, K103, T111, E147, Y189, E195; canonical positions 38, 43, 47, 55, 69, 97, 112, 119, 122, 130, 166, 208, 214 — all verified by Python with offset +19). These are single-amino-acid substitutions (one residue replaced by bicyclononyne-lysine, BCNK) followed by bioorthogonal click labeling; they are point substitutions, not insertions of a peptide sequence, and therefore do not satisfy the ledger criterion of 'an insertion actually tolerated.' L5 names K97B (mature numbering 97 = canonical 122 = K) and Y13B (mature numbering 13 = canonical 38 = Y), which are the same positions as K103 and Y19 in L1 numbering; same disqualification applies. The C-terminal eGFP (L2/L3) is cytoplasmic and is recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal eGFP fused to the cytoplasmic tail of full-length IL-4Rα*; confirmed intracellular (IC domain spans 254–825) and used as an expression marker, not a surface tag.
